info.name: TCOS Finance Tracking — Admin Staff (chompoo)
info.description:
For a single unattended Collection Runner pass across ALL domains, use `TCOS-Full-Suite.postman_collection.json` instead.

The 4 admin staff endpoints — POST /admin/staff, POST /admin/staff/import, PATCH /admin/staff/:id, DELETE /admin/staff/:id. See docs/backend/03-api-spec.md §5.

Self-contained: includes its own Login request so this collection runs standalone without needing the Auth collection open too. Run order: 1. Login (admin) → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5, in that order — Create Staff sets `created_staff_id`, which Update/Delete then reuse.

All 4 routes require `requireRole("admin")` — real, checked straight off the JWT (not the mock-gated scope system) — so the logged-in account must actually have role `admin`. The default `admin_email` below already does.

request.description:
Not one of the 4 endpoints — a harmless request to hang these notes on.

1. Run "1. Login (admin)" first — sets `access_token` automatically. `admin_email` must belong to a staff row with `role: admin` (the default already does).
2. Run "2. Create Staff" — sets `created_staff_id` automatically from the response, which "4. Update Staff" and "5. Delete Staff" reuse. Run them in order.
3. "3. Import Staff (CSV)" needs a real file attached to its Body tab (form-data, key `file`) — Postman can't embed one in a portable collection. See that request's description for a ready-to-save sample CSV.
4. All 4 routes 403 unless the logged-in account's `role` is exactly `admin` — try logging in as `mark@tcos.app` / `Passw0rd!2026` (role: staff) instead to see the rejection.

request.description: #1 — same real login endpoint as the Auth collection, included here so this collection is self-contained. Sets `access_token` for every request below.

#10 — provisions the identity only, no password — the staff member sets their own via POST /auth/claim. 409 DUPLICATE_EMAIL if that email already exists (case-insensitive); re-run with a different email if you've already run this once. Sets `created_staff_id` for the next two requests.

#11 — attach a real CSV to the `file` field in the Body tab (Postman can't embed a file in a portable collection JSON, you need to pick one locally). All-or-nothing: if ANY row fails validation (missing field, bad email, duplicate email in the file, duplicate against a live staff row, or an unknown `department_id`), the whole import is rejected with `error.details` listing every failing row, and nothing is inserted.

`department_id` is an optional column — a real `department._id` (UUID), not a department name. Leave it blank and that row is still imported fine, just with no department assigned; staff_dept was originally scoped as manual-only (see docs/backend/03-api-spec.md §5), added here on request 2026-07-27.

Use `api/tests/fixtures/staff-import.csv` (already in the repo) for a clean import — 2 rows, `import1@tcos.app` (assigned to the seeded Finance department) / `import2@tcos.app` (no department, column left blank). Re-running the same file twice will 400 on the second run (duplicate emails against what you just inserted) — expected, not a bug; delete those two rows or edit the emails to try again.

#12 — whitelist is nickname/phone/line_id/title/first_name/last_name/email/role (anything else is silently dropped by zod before this ever runs). 409 DUPLICATE_EMAIL if changing `email` to one already used by someone else. 404 if `created_staff_id` doesn't exist — run "2. Create Staff" first.

#13 — soft-delete (`deleted_at`), not a hard delete. Doesn't cascade — any reimbursements/approvals already attributed to this staff member are untouched. A deactivated staff member can no longer log in. 404 if `created_staff_id` doesn't exist.
